summary_points.text: Councilman Espinosa thanked Councilman Flynn for his work with the task force on the bill, which stays in the block vote
Council Bill 17-0156, a contingency fund allocation for an investment with a developer, was on second reading for final consideration
A councilwoman opposed it: no direct contract with the retailer and not enough quality full-time jobs; Councilman Espinosa opposed it for lack of explanation of its benefit to the 16th Street Mall
In the roll-call vote the bill passed with eight ayes and two nays

decisions.text: Council Bill 17-0156 passed on final consideration with eight ayes and two nays
The bill championed by Councilman Flynn stays in the block vote

unresolved_issues.text: Concerns that there is no direct contract with the retailer and not enough quality full-time jobs
